news.text: 🙏 Great work, everyone! Please be completely honest — we WANT to hear about anything confusing, slow, ugly or missing. You won't hurt anyone's feelings, and every real problem you find earns 50 KES extra. If a step works but felt confusing, tap 🤷 Not sure and tell us why.

🎉 Karibu Maurice, our newest tester! Kevin has now finished two apps (Break-Even and Ahead of It · Nonprofit), and Ruth, Kevin and Maurice have started One Thing. Keep going — if a step is unclear, tap 😕 I’m stuck and carry on.

🔧 Thanks to Zipporah, two things are clearer now: (1) if an app shows a $ sign, just type the numbers as written — shillings work the same; (2) steps about an iPhone "Home Screen" pop-up now say so — on other phones, ignore that part.

🌟 You're doing a great job! Kevin has already finished his first app with full marks — well done! Every app you finish earns 120 KES, and every real problem you find helps us make Daraja better. Keep going, and asante sana! — Jerry
🔊 The Break-Even video had no sound — fixed! Tap ▶ Watch again. Still silent? Turn your phone's volume up and tap 🔊 Sound on inside the video.
Karibu, everyone! Thank you for testing. Start with the practice app, then do as many apps as you like. If you get stuck, use 😕 I’m stuck and keep going — you never have to wait for me. — Jerry

🔥 New: daily use and streak pay! Every app you finish now joins “📅 Today’s uses” at the top of your page. From the next day, do its small daily job (2–5 minutes) and tap ✅ I used it today. 7 days in a row with one app = +150 KES. A 3-day testing streak = +50 KES, 7 days = +150 KES. 🏆 And every week (Friday to Thursday) there are prizes: longest streak, bug hunter, best idea and most apps finished — 500 KES each — plus ⭐ Tester of the week, 1,000 KES. Details under ❓ Common questions. — Jerry

answers.q: The challenge is in shillings but the app shows dollars — how do I change the currency?
answers.a: You don't need to! The $ sign is only a label. Type the numbers exactly as the challenge gives them and the app works the same. Sorry for the confusion — and thank you for telling us.
